blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Digital transformation of the supply chain, at the senior level, is not about installing more software. It is about redesigning the flows of information so that decisions can be made faster, earlier, and with better evidence. The technology is only the visible layer. Underneath it sit harder questions about data quality, organisational habits, and the willingness of people to trust a number they did not calculate themselves.

A good transformation has three ingredients. First, a clear view of which decisions become significantly better with more and faster data — not all of them do. Second, an honest assessment of the organisation's actual ability to use that data, which is almost always lower than senior leaders believe. And third, a long patience: most supply chain transformations take years to pay off, and the ones that try to rush the timeline tend to fail quietly.

Done well, the result is not dramatic — it is a supply chain that feels slightly calmer, slightly faster, and slightly more accurate every year. Done badly, it is a museum of expensive software that nobody uses.

items.q: According to the text, digital transformation of the supply chain is primarily about…
options: redesigning how information flows so decisions improve
items.why: "It is about redesigning the flows of information so that decisions can be made faster, earlier, and with better evidence."

items.q: What does the author say about an organisation's actual ability to use data?
options: It is almost always lower than senior leaders believe
It is usually higher than expected
items.why: "an honest assessment of the organisation's actual ability to use that data, which is almost always lower than senior leaders believe."

items.q: The phrase "the technology is only the visible layer" suggests that…
options: the real difficulties lie beneath it, in data and behaviour
visibility is the main goal of transformation
only visible results matter to leaders
software is the hardest part of the programme
items.why: Inferência: abaixo da camada visível estão as questões mais difíceis — qualidade dos dados, hábitos e confiança.

items.q: Which statement would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: More and faster data improves every decision equally.
Trusting an externally calculated number is a real hurdle.
Rushing the timeline tends to cause quiet failure.
A good result accumulates gradually, year by year.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz explicitamente "not all of them do" — nem toda decisão melhora com mais dados.

items.q: What does the image of a "museum of expensive software" imply about a poor transformation?
options: The programme finished ahead of schedule
The software is preserved for historical value
The tools are too advanced for the staff
The investment sits unused and delivers nothing
items.why: Inferência: um museu de software é tecnologia cara comprada e nunca usada — o oposto do resultado desejado.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily conduzindo a revisão da transformação, três anos depois do início. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Right, three years in, let me be candid about where we actually stand. Roughly half of what we invested in has paid off, and the other half has quietly become a museum of software nobody opens.

The forecasting engine is the clear win. Driven by the new data feeds, it has cut our error by close to thirty percent, and the trading desk now trusts a number it did not calculate itself. That shift in behaviour, more than the code, is what changed.

The logistics platform is the disappointment. Having been rolled out before we standardised the underlying processes, it simply automated the mess we already had, faster. That is on us, not on the vendor.

So here is what I am asking of this group. Before we sign off on the next phase, I want an honest assessment of which decisions genuinely get better with more data — and which do not. We will not fund another tool until the process behind it is fixed. And please, let us protect the timeline. The pieces that worked took patience; the pieces that failed were the ones we rushed.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How does Emily describe the state of the programme after three years?
options: About half paid off; the other half is unused software
Everything has paid off ahead of schedule
The whole platform is being cancelled
items.why: "Roughly half of what we invested in has paid off, and the other half has quietly become a museum of software nobody opens."

items.q: According to Emily, what is the clearest success?
options: The forecasting engine, which cut error by nearly thirty percent
items.why: "The forecasting engine is the clear win… it has cut our error by close to thirty percent."

items.q: Why did the logistics platform disappoint?
options: The data feeds were never connected
It was rolled out before the processes were standardised
The trading desk refused to use it
items.why: "Having been rolled out before we standardised the underlying processes, it simply automated the mess we already had, faster."

items.q: When Emily says "That is on us, not on the vendor," she is…
options: accepting internal responsibility for the failure
items.why: Inferência: ela assume que a culpa é da própria organização, não do fornecedor.

items.q: What lesson does Emily draw about the timeline?
options: The parts that were rushed are the ones that failed
Timelines should be set by the vendor
The whole programme should have been faster
items.why: Inferência: "the pieces that worked took patience; the pieces that failed were the ones we rushed."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The board wanted an honest assessment of the risks before committing." An honest assessment is…
items.why: Honest assessment = avaliação honesta, franca e realista, sem maquiar os problemas.

items.q: Choose the correct term: "The desk priced on stale figures because the ___ between the two offices broke down."
items.why: Flow of information = fluxo de informação, o que falhou entre os escritórios.

items.q: "No amount of software fixes poor data quality." Data quality refers to…
options: how accurate and reliable the data is
items.why: Data quality = qualidade dos dados: sua exatidão e confiabilidade, não o volume.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The transformation stalled because people lacked the ___ to trust a number they did not calculate themselves."
items.why: Willingness = disposição, vontade — o texto trata da relutância em confiar em dados externos.

items.q: "Most of these programmes only pay off with long patience." This phrase means…
options: a willingness to wait years for results
items.why: Long patience = longa paciência: aceitar que o retorno leva anos para aparecer.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões de transformação digital. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The CFO still has to sign off on the next phase of funding." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We plan to roll out the platform region by region." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = implementar de forma progressiva, aos poucos.

items.q: "Two regional heads pushed back on automating the process." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, contestar — sem necessariamente rejeitar de vez.

items.q: "The team endorsed the roadmap but never followed through." They…
options: failed to carry it to completion
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim aquilo que foi combinado; aqui, o oposto aconteceu.

items.q: "Another dashboard will not move the needle on forecast accuracy." This means it will…
items.why: Move the needle = mexer o ponteiro, fazer uma diferença perceptível no resultado.
